total_boundary: From evaluate() entry through input validation, aggregation, folds, model fits, predictions, selections, metric/statistical computation and output writes, stopping before the final runtime/summary manifest serialization
shared_ensemble_accounting: One fit/prediction record for ensemble5; mean/risk variants reuse those predictions and each receive a separate selection record. Do not count shared stages twice.
neural_boundary: Representation preparation, checkpoint/cache operations and device transfers performed by fit/predict APIs are included in their respective call timers; feature_preparation=0 means included within these calls, not absent
excluded_before_evaluation: database setup/data loading and measurement profiling
comparison_rule: These evaluation times cannot establish end-to-end speedups against competitors unless all methods report matching acquisition/synthesis/representation/training/inference/selection boundaries on the same workload and hardware
overhead: Input loading, fold assembly, normalization, aggregation, statistics, bookkeeping and serialization are included in workflow total but not assigned to model stage records
